{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("\nColumns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("\nFirst few rows:\")
print(df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("\nCount of -1 in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue format
print("\nUnique values in revenue (first 10):", df['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check for QA orders
print("\nQA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nRefunded orders:", (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Check presence of 'loyal' segment
print("\nUnique customer_segment values:", df['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check presence of completed orders for loyal
print("\nCompleted orders for loyal customers:", (df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed'))
print("Count:", ((df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')).sum())"}
